methods.description: Evaluate a negative base with an even positive whole-number index using repeated factors.
Evaluate a negative base with an odd positive whole-number index using repeated factors.
Predict the sign from the base and positive whole-number index without evaluating.
Evaluate the power before applying a separate outside minus sign.
Compare bracketed negative bases with an outside minus sign for even and odd indices.
Use a given power value and the sign of the required power.
Explain why negating both factors, or a base with an even index, preserves the value.
Evaluate signed powers and compare their values.
